about.name: Maple
about.description: Maple Finance is an institutional capital marketplace powered by blockchain technology.
about.methodology: TVL is the cash held by Maple pools on Ethereum, including cash deployed to yield strategies, plus borrower collateral: the balances of the collateral tokens at the custody addresses Maple publishes for each pool, read on the chain where they are held (BTC on Bitcoin, XRP on the XRP Ledger, ETH, wstETH, PYUSD and other tokens on Ethereum). Collateral Maple reports that is not held at those addresses is not counted. Borrowed is the principal outstanding in the pools' loan managers. Staking is SYRUP deposited in stSYRUP.

raises.note: Amounts are in millions of USD, as reported by DefiLlama.

methodology.Fees: Total interest and fees paid by borrowers on both fixed-term and open-term loans, including net interest, management fees, service fees, strategy fees and origination fees, plus off-chain OTC desk revenue.
methodology.Revenue: Total revenue flowing to Maple protocol and delegates, including management fees, service fees, strategy fees and origination fees from both fixed-term and open-term loans.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Revenue flowing to Maple protocol treasuries, i.e. total revenue less the share allocated to SYRUP buybacks.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Net interest earned by liquidity providers/depositors in Maple pools from both fixed-term and open-term loan payments, after the management fee the pool takes out of that interest.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Share of revenue used to buy back SYRUP tokens: 20% from Jan 2025 (MIP-013/016), 25% from Jul 2025 (MIP-019), and from Jul 2026 10%, 20% or 30% of each month's revenue for months under $1.5M, $1.5M-$2M or above $2M (MIP-021).

token.name: Maple Finance
